purpose: Representative carrier list for the kt carrier census (Lists phase): the one Limitless top-30 archetype whose lists carry a switch-1 card (groups 1 to 3 of cards.md) in numbers. Reports only; decides nothing and changes no rule. Whether the Dragonair overlap makes this 'Dustin's deck' for clause (d) is Dustin's call; both readings are given under dustin_readings with their numbers, and this file takes no position.
source: Cowork Limitless pull: rl/results/limitless_skill_model_2026-09-25/raw/6a7e2b83cdc0391d7fa65afb_standings.json.gz (development-split event per split.json; the entry player=thefossilman, decklist field as pulled, energy ["Fire", "Lightning"]). The pick was chosen from carrier_entries.csv (the archetype's 141 carrier entries are present there even though census.csv marks the archetype dustin=True), so no raw scan was needed to find it; the raw standings were opened only to read the chosen entry and five alternatives.

archetype_status: Sept-10 top-30 rank 22 (56 players, decks/classifier/limitless_2026-09-10.json); window rank 6 by development-half match count (818 decisive-or-tie records by the census rule, 857 by the recount's every-row rule; census.csv / recount_diff.md). 143 development-half lists with a decklist in 44 events (all 20 cards, one deck id); 141 carry at least one census card; 135 carry Gouging Fire B3a 054 (132 with 2 copies, 3 with 1 copy; 267 copies in all), plus Protective Poncho in 34 lists and Rocky Helmet in 1. The six carrier entries without Gouging Fire carry Poncho and/or Rocky Helmet only (group 4). Every other top-30 archetype has 0 switch-1 carriers except Suicune ex Baxcalibur (Frigibax P-B 037 in 22 lists) and Vespiquen ex Shuckle ex (Blue in 4 lists); see census.csv.

dustin_readings.what_this_file_does: Presents both readings with the numbers and takes no position. Dustin decides whether the Dragonair overlap makes Rayquaza his deck for clause (d).
dustin_readings.reading_1_conservative_shares_pokemon: The census's mechanical rule (scan_census.py dustin_verdict, level 'shares_pokemon'): an archetype is Dustin's if any Pokémon in its name is a card in any decks/dustin or decks/brews file. Dragonair is in the archetype name and 2 Dragonair B4 117 are in decks/dustin/11-archaludon-haxorus-dragonair.txt (named in the file name), so census.csv marks the archetype dustin=True. The recount's hand-written map (recount.py DUSTIN_MAPPED) reaches the same verdict for the same reason and labels it CONSERVATIVE: 'Dragonair B4 117 is a named main of decks/dustin/11; no Mega Rayquaza ex in his files'. Under this reading the archetype is Dustin's and does not satisfy clause (d).
dustin_readings.reading_2_main_pokemon: By the main-Pokémon reading (the archetype's attacker that names it, Mega Rayquaza ex, decides): Mega Rayquaza ex B4 120 is in no decks/dustin or decks/brews file, Gouging Fire B3a 054 is in none, and a grep of decks/ for 'Rayquaza' and 'Gouging' finds nothing. Dustin's deck 11 is a Fighting/Metal Archaludon-Haxorus deck that uses Dragonair as its energy engine; this list is a Fire/Lightning deck whose attackers are Gouging Fire and Mega Rayquaza ex. Under this reading the archetype is not Dustin's and is the one top-30 archetype that satisfies clause (d) with a usable decklist.
dustin_readings.overlap_numbers: Shared printing ids with decks/dustin/11-archaludon-haxorus-dragonair.txt: 5 of the list's 13 ids (Dragonair B4 117 x2, Poké Ball P-A 005 x2, Professor's Research P-A 007 x2, Rainbow Cave B4 155 x2, Copycat B1 225 x1 of the list's 2); 9 of 20 copies in common. Same name, different printing: Dratini (list A1 183, deck 11 B4 116). List-only: Gouging Fire, Mega Rayquaza ex, Cyrus, Professor Sada, Skull Fossil, Ancient Booster Energy Capsule, Small Balloon. Deck-11-only: Duraludon, Archaludon, Axew, Fraxure, Haxorus, Iris, Lucky Ice Pop. Energy lines differ (Fire, Lightning vs Fighting, Metal).

selection_rule: B2e rule: among the archetype's development-half entries that carry Gouging Fire B3a 054 (carrier_entries.csv), best placing first, larger event as the tiebreaker.
selection_note: 141 carrier entries in 43 development events; 135 carry Gouging Fire (in 41 events). Two carrier entries placed 1st: thefossilman (219 players, Umbreon99's Aura Sphere #4, 2026-09-11, 11-2-1) and minato (146, random r0zey pop up #3, 2026-09-13, 11-1-0); thefossilman's is the larger event, so it wins. Next by the rule: victorssito 2nd of 112 (The Breakfast Club Daily #5, 2026-09-10, 8-3-1), minato 2nd of 112 (LeoWizard BattleTower Cup #12, 2026-09-19, 9-3-0), megaanyaex 3rd of 83 (The PokeBounty Showdown Sunday Pop Up, 2026-09-13, 7-2-1), then pauk55 3rd of 37, niev 3rd of 17, draxoz 3rd of 14, minato 4th of 142, harian 5th of 219 (same event as the pick). The largest event in the window with a Gouging Fire carrier is PMPT #44 (378 players, 2026-08-29), where the archetype's best carrier placed 102nd (loulougame2310); it would not win under any placing-first reading. 28 of the 135 Gouging Fire carriers have no placing (dropped); they sort last. Holdout event standings were not opened (split.json lists them; only development ids were read, asserted before each open).

printings: All 13 ids copied verbatim from the API decklist (set + zero-padded number) and resolved with python lib/card.py "<SET> <NUM>": each reports '1 printings, 1 distinct', so no printing choice was needed. Dratini has four printings across the archetype's 143 development lists (B2b 051 in 54, B4 116 in 45, A3b 051 in 25, A1 183 in 23); the file keeps the source's A1 183. Gouging Fire is B3a 054 in every carrier (its only printing); Mega Rayquaza ex is B4 120 x1 in all 143 lists.
energy_line: The API entry declares energy ["Fire", "Lightning"], so the file's first line is 'Energy: Fire, Lightning' straight from the source; nothing was derived. For context, of the archetype's 143 development-half lists, 101 declare exactly 'Fire, Lightning' and 42 declare nothing; no list declares any other combination. The declared types pay Gouging Fire's [RLC] and Mega Rayquaza ex's [RL]; Dratini A1 183's Ram costs [WL] and cannot be paid from this Energy line, so Dratini is an evolution base in this list.
diff_vs_panel: The archetype is not one of the eight panel decks (decks/screen/opponents has no Rayquaza file), so there is no panel twin to diff against.
